title: Buying Class H Preferred Stock up to the Purchase Room — Member Equities & Patronage Member Purchase Terms and Platform Reference
content:
A member may buy as much Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock as the rules allow at once.

## Rule

1. A member who asks to buy as much Class H Preferred Stock as the rules allow at once buys, on their own authorization and paid by an electronic draw from the checking account on record, the purchase room.
2. The purchase room is fixed only after the holding carries the cancellation entry for every share that a purchase took above its quarter's purchase allowance.
3. Before the purchase room is worked out, every reinvested dividend earned by cancelled shares must stand reversed on the holding.

## Business effect

A purchase entry dated today is recorded on the member's preferred stock holding for the dollar amount bought, at 1.00 par per share, paid by an electronic draw from the checking account recorded for direct deposit on the holding, and the holding's balance rises by the amount. The member then sees the purchase reference and the new balance.

## Platform reference: `submit_preferred_purchase_895be76e`

**Capability.** Places the member's own purchase of additional Class H Preferred Stock on their preferred holding, for the dollar amount given.

**How it is invoked.** This is the member's own act. The servicing representative unlocks `submit_preferred_purchase_895be76e` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the member — authorizes and submits the purchase.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `equity_id` | The reference number of the member's own Class H Preferred Stock holding, read to the member by the servicing agent from the equity holdings lookup | Identifier, text |
| `amount` | The dollar amount of preferred stock bought | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** On success a receipt with `status` "purchased"; `eq_txn_id`, the reference of the purchase entry (text); `equity_id`, the holding (text); `amount`, the USD bought (2 decimal places); `payment_method`, always `direct_deposit`; `effective_date`, today (YYYY-MM-DD); and `new_balance`, the holding's balance afterwards (USD, 2 decimal places).

## Contract questions

**How is the purchase paid?** By an electronic draw from the checking account recorded for direct deposit on the holding; the receipt shows `direct_deposit`.

**Which date does the purchase carry?** Today.
